cues: Plot z equals x plus i y as the point x, y on the Argand diagram: real axis across, imaginary axis up.
Its distance from the origin is the modulus, r, root of x squared plus y squared.
Its angle from the positive real axis is the argument, theta.
text: Plot z equals x plus i y as the point x, y on the Argand diagram: real axis across, imaginary axis up. Now describe it differently. Its distance from the origin is the modulus, r, root of x squared plus y squared. Its angle from the positive real axis is the argument, theta.
